snippet.title: Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate – Battling with Sora – Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
The iconic Keyblade wielder arrives to the battlefield! Sora from KINGDOM HEARTS will be the final Super Smash Bros.™ Ultimate DLC fighter! Look forward to the release of Sora in Challenger Pack 11 on 10/18. Learn more: https://smashbros.nintendo.com/buy/dlc/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01
